image_description: A cluster of approximately six to seven Blenheim Spaniel puppies sleeping in a tight pile on a textured beige surface. The puppies exhibit the characteristic chestnut-red and white parti-color coat. Most are curled up with heads tucked in, obscuring facial features, though one puppy on the right shows its side profile. The fur appears soft and fluffy, typical of young puppies.
